part: Running gear of the speedrun chassis: wheel suspension (front C-hubs with steering knuckles, rear hub carriers), axles with hex hubs, CVD drive shafts, steering (posts, bellcranks, links), servo with the floating servo mount, dampers and sway bars. Own design of the owner, partly based on the Carten T410R and deviating from it where the function requires; not verified. Files: cad/running_gear, generated with scripts/cad/generate_running_gear.py.
coordinate_system: Chassis plate coordinates (assembly): x across the car (+x right side seen toward End A), y along the car (End B at y = 0, End A front), z = 0 bottom face of the chassis plate. The parts of the right side are built and mirrored to the left side (x -> -x).

source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual (design principle, sizes of screws, pins and bearings)
source_codes.derived: Calculated from other parts of the model
source_codes.design: Design choice for the function (own design, not measured)
source_codes.measured: Measured by the owner on the original part (caliper)

ride_height.note: Ride height front (End A) and rear (End B), setup sheet 4: axle heights 22.0 and 17.0 above the bottom face of the chassis plate.

wheel_centre_x.note: Wheel centre plane of the original car: overall width 187 over the tyres of 26 mm (owner, measured on the car): outer edge of the tyre at 93.5, wheel centre at 80.5. On the original car the outer faces of the rear hex hubs lie at approx. 86.85 (measured rear wishbone and hub carrier), so the wheel centre lies approx. 6.35 inside the outer face of the hex hub. With tyres of 30 mm (setup sheet 4) the original car is 191 wide. The model places the hex hubs at 90.2 (front kingpin position as design value, rear wishbones extended to match): approx. 193.7 over the tyres of 26 mm, 197.7 over the tyres of 30 mm.

caster.note: Caster of the front kingpins (setup sheet 4), top toward the middle of the car.

kingpin_x.note: Front kingpin axis at the height of the axle; the centre of the outer CVD joint lies on it. Equal track front and rear (owner): the outer faces of the front hex hubs (kingpin + ring of the knuckle 16.7 + 0.5 + hex hub 6) line up with the rear ones (86.85). The kingpin lies 6.75 inside the outer hinge pin (front wishbone prolonged to 49.7), so the lower bore 5.0 and the head of the lower screw stay outside the tube on the hinge pin (radius 3.6): 0.65 and 0.4 clearance. Position along the car: see kingpin_y.

kingpin_y.note: Front kingpin axis at the height of the axle 2.0 toward the middle of the car from the middle of the front wishbone (owner). With the caster of 10 degrees the axis lies 2.0 to 2.7 toward the front end of the car in the lower arm of the C-hub (2.4 to 4.4 below the axle); the lower arm lies between the rails of the wishbone (inner faces +-6.2) and is centred on the middle of the wishbone. Without the offset the lower bore 5.0, the counterbore of the lower flange and the former pocket of the screw head left walls of 0.55, 0.34 and 0.19 to the front face of the lower arm. With the offset the axis lies in the middle between the rails at the height of the lower arm: walls of 2.27 or more to both faces (output of the generator). The knuckle, the axle and the wheel move with the axis: wheelbase approx. 257.8 (T410R: 258); the front CVD drive shafts run at 2.8 degrees to the axis of the diff in the top view.

front_c_hub.note: Front C-hub: back plate from x to x, radius of the passage of the CVD drive shaft (owner: passage 10, the bone with its cross pin passes through), axial clearance to the knuckle at the top and the bottom (along the kingpin axis), thickness of the upper arm along the kingpin axis above its face toward the upper boss (top face square to the kingpin axis at 21.1 / 2 + 0.5 + 4.0 = 15.05 from the axle along the axis; the top guide sleeve, inserted from below, stands 0.1 proud of it under the ball stud of the camber link). The C-hub is built in 2 frames (owner: the caster lies between the bore of the outer hinge pin and the kingpin bores): the lug on the outer hinge pin, the lower arm and the back plate below the start of the wide part lie between the rails of the wishbone and are centred on the middle of the wishbone; the wide part of the back plate and the upper arm are parallel to the kingpin axis and centred on it. The bottom face of the lower arm and of the narrow back plate is square to the kingpin axis (caster angle), 0.1 above the lower end of the lower guide sleeve: the sleeve stands 0.1 proud, the head of the screw bears only on the sleeve (owner). The back plate is closed (no slot, no pocket): the steering arm of the knuckle lies at the height of the axle and does not reach the back plate. The upper arm is solid from 1.0 above the ring of the knuckle up to its top, with a U-slot around the upper boss of the knuckle (0.5 clearance, open toward the wheel, so the knuckle slides in); only the boss turns in this space. Kingpin bores 5.0 for the guide sleeves (owner, see guide_sleeve). The kingpin bores and the faces toward the knuckle are square to the kingpin axis, so the knuckle turns with a constant clearance.

front_c_hub_width.note: Width (y) of the C-hub: lower arm and back plate below the start of the wide part (between the rails of the wishbone, inner faces +-6.2; centred on the middle of the wishbone), wide part of the back plate above it (15, parallel to the kingpin axis and centred on it: 2.5 wall beside the passage 10; free steering angle toward the middle approx. 35 degrees), upper arm (as wide as the back plate, centred on the kingpin axis), height of the start of the wide part (z, horizontal bottom face of the wide part: 0.3 above the shock plate of the front wishbone, which ends 2.95 inside the back plate). The lug on the outer hinge pin is 13.0 long (outer gap of the wishbone 13.3).

knuckle.note: Front steering knuckle as the T410R knuckle (original part measured by the owner, measurement sheet K; manual step 15), built in the frame of the kingpin axis (origin in the centre of the outer CVD joint, x along the axle): bottom and top of the kingpin bosses along the kingpin axis (K8: 21.1 between the end faces, symmetric to the axle axis), radius of the bosses (K7: 7.0), radius of the ring (K1: 14.1), ring from x to x (K10: the inner end face lies on the kingpin axis; K2: 16.7 long), inner diameter of the lip between the bearings (K6: not measurable, the lip is approx. 1 high: 10 - 2 x 1), radius of the entry bore around the joint cup of the axle (K21: 12.4; the step to the bearing seat holds the end of the CVD drive shaft). 2 bearings 5x10x4 (manual) are pressed in from both ends against the lip (see knuckle_bores). The bosses sit on the kingpin axis above and below the inner end of the ring.

knuckle_bores.note: Bores of the knuckle: diameter of the bearing seats (K3: measured 9.98 on the original part, press fit of the bearings 10.0 within the accuracy of a caliper; the model uses the nominal 10.0 as the bearing seats of the bulkheads), length of each bearing seat from the end of the bore to the lip (K4: 4.29; the bearings rest on the lip, the outer bearing lies 0.29 below the end face), length of the entry bore from the inner end face (K21: 5.79, section of the joint cup of the axle; the joint cup reaches up to 0.2 before the step, a shoulder 6.5 rests on the inner race of the inner bearing), diameter of the kingpin bores in the bosses (K9: 2.7, depth 4.5 from the end face of the boss; the bores end at the entry bore). The lip is the rest (K5, not measurable, calculated by the owner): 16.7 - 5.79 - 2 x 4.29 = 2.33. Kingpins: set screws M3x8 threaded into the bores 2.7 (thread formed by the screw, 4.3 long in the boss); they turn with the knuckle in the bores 3.1 of the C-hub. The top set screw is inserted from above through the upper arm of the C-hub, the bottom set screw from below before the outer hinge pin.

guide_sleeve.note: Guide sleeves of the kingpins (owner: bores 5.0 in the C-hub, sleeves just under 5.0 so that they fit without pressing; manual step 15: 2 flanged sleeves per knuckle): outer diameter, inner diameter (the screw M3 passes), flange diameter and thickness (manual drawing scaled to the outer diameter), head of the lower screw M3x8 (socket head: diameter, height). Both sleeves are the same part (shank 3.6, total length 4.6: foot 1.0 as modelled (manual drawing, owner: approx. 0.6, to be measured)). Both sleeves are inserted from the knuckle side (owner): top sleeve from below, its foot in a counterbore (7.0 x 0.55) of the upper arm between the arm and the upper boss, the shank 0.1 proud of the top face of the upper arm (square to the kingpin axis); the ball stud 4.8x9 of the camber link clamps the sleeve to the knuckle (as the original), the ball sits on the kingpin axis. Bottom: bore 5.0 through the lower arm, flange inside in a counterbore of the lower arm (thrust face toward the lower boss); a socket head screw M3x8 from below clamps the sleeve to the knuckle (the original M3x10 would reach into the entry bore of the knuckle); the bottom face of the C-hub is square to the kingpin axis (caster angle, owner) and the lower end of the sleeve stands 0.1 proud of it, so the head of the screw bears only on the sleeve (owner). Knuckle, sleeves and screws turn together in the bores 5.0 of the C-hub. The outer hinge pin lies 6.75 beside the kingpin axis: the bore 5.0 and the head of the screw stay outside the tube on the hinge pin (0.65 and 0.4 to its outer surface).

guide_sleeve_proud.note: Both guide sleeves stand 0.1 proud of the C-hub (owner): the upper end of the top sleeve above the top face of the upper arm (the ball stud of the camber link clamps only the sleeve) and the lower end of the lower sleeve below the bottom face of the lower arm (the head of the screw M3x8 bears only on the sleeve). Both faces are square to the kingpin axis; the knuckle moves freely.

steering_arm_ball.note: Steering arm of the knuckle as the T410R knuckle (measured by the owner): x of the ball stud relative to the kingpin axis (outer hole; K13: 5.0 toward the chassis; K12: then 25.0 square to it toward the middle of the car), y relative to the kingpin axis, thickness of the flat arm (along the kingpin axis; K15: 4.9 at the end tab), thickness of the gussets at the bosses (K16, not measured), distance of the second hole toward the ring (K14, not measured), height of the middle plane of the arm above the axle axis (K17: 0, in the middle, owner), width of the end tab (K18: 7.4). The arm has a wide root along the ring, runs diagonally inboard and ends in a tab straight back with the 2 holes. Ball stud on top of the arm (as the original); the steering link runs from the bellcrank ball (26.3) down to the knuckle ball (24.0 above the bottom face of the chassis plate). With the bellcranks of this model the original ball position gives Ackermann 102 / 115 / 130 % at 15 / 20 / 25 degrees of the inner wheel.

rear_carrier.note: Rear hub carrier as the original part (photos of the owner), in the frame of the rear arm (x along the arm from the outer hinge pin): length of the tube (bearing housing, owner: 10; its outer end is flush with the lug on the outer hinge pin), outer diameter of the tube (photo, scaled with the bearing seat 10: approx. 14.6), width of the web on the inner end of the tube (design), top (z, seat of the camber stud). Lower lug between 2 spacers 3x7x3 on the outer hinge pin. The 2 bearings 5x10x4 sit in the ends of the tube against a lip of 2.0. A sloped arm runs from the inner end of the tube up to the seat of the camber stud (photo); the position of the camber ball comes from the camber link. The original part has 2 holes in the top tab (positions of the camber stud, photo); the model has the one at the position of the camber link.

axle.note: Axles: diameter in the bearings 5x10x4 (manual), thread M4 at the end for the wheel nut, outer diameter (owner: 10) and length of the joint cup.

hex_hub.note: Hex hubs 12 mm (spec_tires.yaml), width front and rear (manual: 6 and 7 mm; the rear gains 2 mm of track, as on the car of the owner), pin 2x10 through the axle in a slot of the hub, grub screw M3x3.

cvd.note: CVD drive shafts: bone diameter, end balls, cross pins 2x8 in the slots of the outdrive cups and of the joint cups of the axles.

post.note: Steering posts on H24/H25 (owner): hexagon 5.5 across the flats, height of the hexagon, journal 5.0 for 2 bearings 5x8x2.5, height of the post above the top face of the chassis plate (owner: 20.3, as the original part), diameter of the shank up to the shoulder (collar) that holds the inner ring of the lower bearing, axial play of the bellcrank: gap between the washer 3.2x6x0.5 under the screw M3x6 on top and the end of the journal. The journal ends flush with the bearing stack (2 x 2.5 and the lip 0.5 of the bellcrank). The thread M3 on top is a blind thread with a full thread depth of 6 - 0.5 - 0.3 = 5.2 (drill 6.2): the screw bottoms at the end of the thread and cannot be screwed in fully, so the washer stays 0.3 above the journal and the bearing and the bellcrank turns freely (owner; on the original post the screw is left a bit proud). Thread M3 from below for the screw through the chassis plate. Material aluminium possible (threads tapped).

bellcrank.note: Symmetric bellcranks (owner: no front and rear, the same part on both sides; arms 15 mm for Ackermann close to 100 % at 20 degrees of the inner wheel): bottom and top (z: the lower bearing sits on the shoulder of the post, height 5.5 = 2 bearings 5x8x2.5 and the lip 0.5; top flush with the end of the journal), length of the ball arm (forward, toward End A), offset of its ball across the car (0: the 3 holes in line), length of the arm to the bridge. Ball of the steering link on top of the front arm (ball with internal thread on a screw M3x8 from below, head in the hex pocket), bridge on the rear arm (2 flanged bearings MF63ZZ in the bridge, screw M3x16 from above, lock nut M3 in the hex pocket). The original part (photos of the owner) has 2 arms of approx. 17 mm at different heights, a hub of approx. 7 mm and windows in the arms.

bellcrank_shape.note: Shape of the bellcrank (MJF 3D print, nylon PA12, owner): the outline is the hull of the hub circle and the 2 end circles, full height. Diameter of the hub, diameter of the ends, bearing seats (2 bearings 5x8x2.5 from both faces, 2.5 deep), thickness of the lip between the bearings (owner), inner diameter of the lip (contact on the outer rings only; inner rings approx. 6.0), through holes at both ends (owner: 3.2), hex pocket from below at both ends (across the flats, depth: lock nut M3 of the bridge screw or head of the ball screw), chamfer 45 degrees of the entries of the bearing seats.

bridge.note: Steering bridge (owner: refined, MJF 3D print in nylon PA12): a flat bar across the car with round ends (towers) on the bellcrank arms. Bottom of the bar (= bottom face of the towers on the bearing flanges, 1.0 above the centre driveshaft, which the bridge passes at up to +-9.9 across the car) and top (flush with the heads of the screws), width of the bar (y), diameter of the towers (bearing seats from the bottom, access bore for the screw from above), diameter of the access bore, width of the boss of the ball (x). The ball of the servo link sits in the middle of the rear face (owner) at half the height of the bar, on a grub screw M3x8 in a thread M3 (owner); the boss reaches back to the y of the horn ball.

bridge_bearings.note: Joint of the bridge on each bellcrank (owner: common purchased parts): 2 flanged bearings MF63ZZ (3x6x2.5) pressed into the tower from both faces (flanges outside), the inner rings clamped on the bellcrank arm by the screw M3x16 from above (lock nut M3 in the hex pocket of the bellcrank) with a shim 3x5x0.3 below and above the stack (the screw head and the bellcrank touch only the inner rings). Values: outer diameter, width, flange diameter, flange width of the bearing; thickness and outer diameter of the shims.

servo.note: Servo Savox SC-1252MG+ (spec_servo.yaml) across the car, output shaft forward: length of the case (spec), height of the case (19.0: from S4 to the lower face of the top plate M4 - M5; owner: caliper values before the spec value 20.2), depth of the case along the car without the spline (25.4 - 3.4, spec), distance of the output shaft from the outer end of the case (assumed), thickness of the ears (S1 - M1: the front faces of the ears are flush with the front face of the case), length of the ears beyond the case (assumed), distance of the ear holes from the end of the case (hole spacing 49.5, assumed), distance between the 2 holes of an ear (assumed). The output shaft lies 13.0 above the lower face of the case (S3 - S4).

servo_position.note: Position of the servo (owner, caliper, measurement sketch S1 to S4, servo on the servo mount of the T410R): front face of the case (output side) ahead of the hole H21 of the servo mount (S1), output shaft across the car from H21 toward the outside (S2), height of the output shaft above the top face of the chassis plate (S3), height of the lower face of the case above it (S4).

servo_mount.note: Floating servo mount as the T410R (manual step 10; owner: caliper M1 to M5 and the drawing of the parts in the manual): a top plate on 2 posts; only the fixed post at the inner end of the servo is screwed onto the chassis plate (H17/H21, threads M3 from below); the floating post (L bracket) at the output end hangs from the top plate. The servo ears are screwed to the front faces of both posts (M3x6 with washers, threads M3 from the front), the top plate to the top faces (M3x6 from above; slots at the floating post). Values: thickness of the top plate (M5), height of its top face above the top face of the chassis plate (M4), width of the fixed post (M3), front face of the fixed post ahead of H21 (M1, contact face of the ears), length of the fixed post (M2 measured 32; 34 so that H17 has 2.25 of material behind it, owner), depth of the top plate along the car (19.6, owner: rear edge straight, at the fixed post it steps forward to the front face of the post), width of the floating post, depth of its leg, thickness of its top flange (assumed), depth of the front and of the rear pillar of the fixed post, height of the bottom of the U-notch from the top and height of the arch from below above the top face of the chassis plate (fixed post seen from the side: H shape as the manual; assumed).

servo_horn.note: Aluminium clamp horn 25T (spec_servo.yaml; owner, caliper): distance from the output shaft to the ball (S7, hole in use; the horn points up in the centre position), width (assumed), thickness (S6), front face of the horn ahead of the front face of the servo case (S5). Ball centre 4.0 ahead of the front face of the horn (S8 = ball_offset).

damper.note: Standard 1:10 on-road damper: body diameter, cap diameter, spring diameter, shaft diameter, body length, spring wire.

sway_bar.note: Sway bars as the T410R (manual step 23, photos of the owner): wire 1.4, height of the bar in the holders (z), position of the holders outside the screw holes of the tabs of the lower bulkhead (y in the coordinates of the bulkhead), half length of the straight part in the holders (screws M3x6 from above into the tabs). The bar is a plain trapezoid (manual step 23): from the straight part a straight leg runs on each side to the ball end above the ball stud of the arm (no bend at the end).

sway_link.note: Drop links of the sway bars (manual step 22): 2 rod ends on a set screw M3x12 with a gap of 3.0 between the rod ends. Rod ends as the camber links (9.0 from the ball centre to the face, assumed): 21.0 between the ball centres. The link stands vertical between the ball stud in rail B of the arm (inner hole) and the ball end of the bar.

sway_ball_end.note: Ball end on each end of the sway bar (aluminium, manual step 23 and photos of the owner): ball for the rod end of the drop link, neck diameter, collar diameter and length, start of the collar from the ball centre. Bore for the bar along the axis up to the ball centre; grub screw M3x3 from the top into the collar (manual step 23). The ball end sits on the axis of the leg.

ball_offset.note: Ball studs: centre of the ball 4.0 from the face of the part (neck 3.0, thread M3 into the part).

damper_plane.note: Dampers in the plane 8.3 in front of the damper face of the shock towers (spring collar 15.0 plus 0.8); the lower ball stud along the hole of the shock plate reaches this plane.

steering_lock.note: Required steering angle of the front knuckles in both directions; the generator reports the free angle (no contact of the knuckle, the axle and the steering arm with the C-hub, the CVD drive shaft and the wishbone).
